objective: Evaluate whether introducing moderate MixUp augmentation (mixup=0.15) resolves overlapping and occluded waste object detection failures in the 768px YOLO11s detector.
hypothesis: In SafaiOS validation error analysis, 88.9% (16 of 18) of all false negatives occurred on overlapping objects. Because E001 and E002 had mixup=0.0, the detector lacks training signal on overlapping co-located objects. Introducing mixup=0.15 will teach the feature backbone and detection head to disentangle overlapping features and independently regress overlapping bounding boxes, reducing overlapping-object false negatives and increasing overall validation mAP@50-95.

expected_measurable_effects.overlapping_false_negatives: Reduction from 16 missed overlapping items in E002 to <= 10 in E003
expected_measurable_effects.overall_val_precision: Maintain >= 99.30% (no significant degradation from synthetic blends)

evaluation_protocol.protected_sets_policy: STRICTLY PROHIBITED: test_locked_v2 and india_real_world must remain untouched

success_criteria.criterion_1_overlap_recall: Recall on overlapping objects (max pairwise IoU >= 0.1) increases to >= 98.20%
success_criteria.criterion_2_map: Validation mAP@50-95 strictly exceeds E002 baseline (target: >= 98.95%)
success_criteria.criterion_3_precision_retention: Validation Precision remains >= 99.20% without excessive false alarm drift
success_criteria.criterion_4_no_per_class_regressions: No individual class suffers a > 0.5% drop in mAP@50-95 compared to E002
